title: Running Min, Max, Sum and Average Until Sentinel

content.problemStatement:
Find the max,min,sum and average of the given n numbers without using array.
Note: -1 will be the termination of the input.
content.outputFormat:
Min = Integer
Max = Integer
Sum = Interger
Average = Float

sampleTestCases.explanation: Input produces the corresponding formatted output according to problem rules.
Input produces the corresponding formatted output according to problem rules.

solution.approach: Read integers until sentinel -1; calculate Min, Max, Sum, and Average formatted to 6 decimal places.

code.Python3:
import sys

def main():
    parts = sys.stdin.read().split()
    nums = []
    for p in parts:
        v = int(p)
        if v == -1: break
        nums.append(v)
    if nums:
        mn = min(nums)
        mx = max(nums)
        s = sum(nums)
        avg = s / len(nums)
        print(f"Min = {mn}")
        print(f"Max = {mx}")
        print(f"Sum = {s}")
        print(f"Average = {avg:.6f}")

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
